data.gender_notes: Bel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Babylonian word ‘belu’, meaning ‘lord’ or ‘god’. In the Bible, Bel is the name of several gods and idols. Bel is a reminder of the power and majesty of the true God. The name Bel carries the meaning “God, Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bel usually hope their child will grow to embody god, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and devotion.
data.etymology: Bel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God, Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: בל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bel is a title given to various gods in the ancient Near East, representing the supreme deity. In Hebrew, 'Bel' is simply the transliteration of the Akkadian word.

in_greek.name: Βέλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, Bel is transliterated as 'Βέλλος' and retains the same meaning as in Hebrew, representing the supreme deity.

in_latin.name: Belus
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, 'Belus' is derived from the Greek 'Βέλλος' and retains the same meaning as in Hebrew and Greek, representing the supreme deity.

in_english.name: Bel
in_english.long_meaning: In English, 'Bel' is a transliteration of the Hebrew or Greek 'Bel' and retains the same meaning as in those languages, representing the supreme deity.

data.cultural_impact: Bel, as a Christian name, is believed to have originated from the Babylonian culture and was influenced by the ancient name ‘belu’ meaning ‘lord’ or ‘god’. It may also have associations with the Babylonian deity Bel or Bäl, commonly depicted as a man with the head of a bull or a bird. Bel is an uncommon name in Western cultures, but it has been used in various Christian communities throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bel holds great spiritual significance for Christians as it serves as a constant reminder of the true God’s power and majesty. In the Bible, Bel refers to several false gods and idols that the people of Israel were tempted to worship. However, through God's grace and love, the Israelites eventually turned away from these idols and renounced their false beliefs. The name Bel is a reminder of the importance of acknowledging and worshiping the One True God, and rejecting idols and false gods. Bel is a powerful name that encourages Christians to stay rooted in their faith and trust in the power and protection of God.
